text_block_list.text:
We seem to be gaining quite positive
results
lately.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: You're getting used to the races too.

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I owe that to the experience I
acquire each
time I hit the course.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And next year, I will be able to attempt
the
Classics, so...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As a stayer, I absolutely want to win the
Kikuka
Sho and its prelude, the Kobe
Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: We'll need to keep focused then!

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't be lax in my training. I shall
maintain
a proper condition to achieve
success in the
Classics!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
